title: Notification system with patterns
idea: A notification system is a good test of pattern judgement: Observer hears events, Strategy delivers per channel, Factory builds channels, and Decorator adds retries.
points: Observer decouples order code from notifications: it publishes events, nothing more.
Each delivery channel is a Strategy behind one `Channel` interface.
A Factory turns a stored preference, such as `SMS`, into a channel object.
A Decorator wraps any channel to add retries without editing the channel.

messages.label: on(SHIPPED, ada)
messages.note: Observer: `OrderService` calls every `OrderListener` and knows none of them by name.

messages.label: create()
messages.note: Factory: Ada's stored preference `SMS` becomes a channel object.

messages.label: sms channel
messages.note: Factory returns the plain SMS strategy. The service wraps it in `Retrying`, still typed `Channel`.

messages.label: send(ada, text)
messages.note: Strategy: the service calls `send` on the interface and never checks the type.

messages.label: send, try 1
messages.note: The decorator passes the call to the real channel.

messages.label: gateway busy
messages.note: The channel throws. The decorator catches it instead of the service.

messages.label: send, try 2
messages.note: The decorator tries again, up to its limit.

messages.label: sent
messages.note: Delivered. Each concern lived in its own small class.

code.title: Strategy, Factory, Decorator
code.caption: The enum builds each channel; the decorator retries the flaky one.

walk.text: Strategy: every channel has the same one-method contract.
Factory: an `enum` method maps a type to a channel with a `switch` expression.
A fake SMS channel that fails its first call, so retries show.
Decorator: a `Channel` that holds another `Channel` and retries it.
`main` builds, wraps and uses each channel through the interface only.

code.title: Observer and preferences
code.caption: Shipping fires one event; listeners react. Here channels are lambdas; in the full design each list holds `new Retrying(type.create(), 3)` built from a stored `ChannelType`.

walk.text: Channels as lambdas, and each user's preferred channels.
The subject: it fires `SHIPPED` and knows only `OrderListener`.
`NotificationService` is one listener; its preferences arrive by constructor.
It builds the text once and sends it on each preferred channel.
An audit lambda is a second listener; the order code is unchanged.

pitfalls: Do not put channel choice inside `OrderService`; it should only publish events.
Retry only errors that may pass, like a busy gateway; never a bad phone number.
Add a pattern only for a change you expect; four patterns for one channel is overkill.

quiz.q: What is the third line `NotifyDemo` prints?
quiz.why: Listeners run in subscribe order. For Ada, `NotificationService` prints two lines, then the audit lambda prints the raw event name.

takeaway: One pattern per concern: hear events, deliver per channel, build channels, add retries.

starters: How would I add a WhatsApp channel to this design?
Where should rate limiting and quiet hours go?
